messages:
Aria: FYI: running a focused hardening drill tomorrow 08:00 PDT on canary-onprem-chi. Scope: RBAC tighten, Vault transit key swap, network policy egress enforcement, and audit forwarding checks. Need 1 infra + 1 sec observer.
Leo: I can be infra. Quick things: which SA will we escalate for the RBAC test?
Aria: Use `system:serviceaccount:infra:emergency-test`. We'll grant ephemeral `cluster-admin` in the dry-run, then revoke. Validate audit shows original principal.
Nina: KMS steps using Vault transit (HSM): `vault write transit/keys/ri-sim rotate` -> `vault write transit/keys/ri-sim disabled=true` -> `vault write transit/keys/ri-sim-promote promote=true`. Ops confirmed standby key synced.
Sam: Netpol: apply deny-all-egress then allow-only to `namespace=outbound-proxy`. Sample provided in runbook. Also apply node-level block to 169.254.169.254 via daemonset on canary nodes.
Aria: Detection: filebeat will tag `test=priv-hardening-chi`, SIEM saved search `test:priv-hardening-chi` should return events within 90s. PagerDuty on MissingAuditRBAC rule.
Leo: Rollback: re-enable key `vault write transit/keys/ri-sim disabled=false`, restart runtime pods, remove netpols. RBAC rollback: reapply backup from s3://runbooks/rbac-backup.yaml.
Nina: Pentest note: confirm vault-proxy version >=2.2.0 on canary. If older, patch before running any key ops.
sec-bot: Incident PRV-HARDEN-2026 created, runbook=/ops/runbooks/priv-hardening-chi.md
Aria: Action items: Nina patch check, Leo apply netpols + node block, Sam tag filebeat mapping, I'll coordinate the 08:00 go/no-go. If any token-forwarding or missing audit events, abort and escalate.
Leo: Got it.
